description: Top-tier Air RB match model for the training environment (docs/rl_design.md sections 1-2). Values are the user's estimates of 2026-10-05 (grade C) unless marked D; ranges are sampled per match.

spawn.notes: User: 2000 m, 900 km/h IAS, about 100 km apart. Forum reports: teams 90-100 km apart, spawn speed differs by aircraft (Mach 0.8-1.2), altitude about 3 km.

excluded.rafale_c_f3: MICA EM not modelled (thrust vectoring unsupported in missle_sim)
excluded.rafale_eg_greece: MICA EM not modelled (thrust vectoring unsupported in missle_sim)
excluded.rafale_m_f3r: MICA EM not modelled (thrust vectoring unsupported in missle_sim)

archetypes.middle: climb, long-range suppression shot near Rmax, then defend outward (left) or go home; recommit when the RWR clears
archetypes.left: climb while flanking left; most defend at once, some fire one suppression shot turning right first; defend by turning left (outward); recommit right when the RWR clears
archetypes.right: mirror of left: flank right, shoot turning left, defend turning right (towards home)
archetypes.crawler: hug the ground, pop up to shoot when close
archetypes.rusher: fly straight at the enemy, shoot at mid range, defend late or not at all
archetypes.spammer: population v2 only: climb, fire two or three missiles near Rmax, drag cold at once; recommit and spam again
archetypes.speedster: population v2 only: climb high and fast; never turns in while a lock or missile is on the RWR, runs cold at full power and comes back when it is gone
archetypes.deck_notcher: population v2 only: down to the deck right after spawn, beam threats down there, shoot from low altitude
archetypes.pair: population v2 only (team of two or more): wingman 3-8 km abeam of a teammate, turns in when the lead does
archetypes.bait: population v2 only (team of two or more): drags a pursuer toward the nearest teammate and turns back when the teammate fires

groups.name: J-16 / Su-30SM2
groups.notes: Their middle players often fire one shot and turn left early (middle.early_left).

prior_jitter: Dirichlet around each group's prior, concentration 20 (D)

population.notes: Population v2 of the scripted pilots (docs/population_spec.md): opt-in with match population="v2" or MatchEnv script_perturbation={"population": "v2"}; without it the v1 scripts fly unchanged. "v2" holds every distribution (grade D unless docs/rl_design.md section 2 gives a C fact); its values equal archetypes.POPULATION_V2, and a value given here overrides that default. Each group's prior_v2_extra is the share of its pilots drawn as a new archetype (spammer, speedster, deck_notcher, pair, bait, pusher; pair and bait only in teams of two or more); the other pilots keep the C-grade prior.

aircraft_frequency.notes: Relative match frequency = battles played per aircraft from statshark.net (screenshots sent by the user, 2026-10-05; lifetime totals, so newer aircraft are under-counted). J-16 has no data yet; the user says it is very common: taken equal to Su-30SM2. MiG-35 was not in the list: 20000 (D). Rafale C F3 245432 and Rafale M F3-R 75234 are excluded until MICA EM is modelled.
aircraft_frequency.source: statshark.net, Air RB vehicle statistics, BR 14.3-14.7

parameters.middle_early_left: J-16 / Su-30SM2 middle players turn left right after one shot

map.notes: War Thunder forum: top-tier Air RB maps grew from 40x40 km to about 128x128 km; engine limit about 130 km (grade C). Teams spawn 90-110 km apart, so near opposite edges.

camera.fov_axis: horizontal assumed (D); if vertical, the 16:9 horizontal FOV would be about 121 deg
camera.free_look: used a lot (user, C): camera leaves the aim direction, the mouse no longer steers, keyboard only

marker_range_km.notes: range limit for target boxes/parameters on screen unknown

contrails.visible_range: unlimited while inside the camera view
